requirement_text: 有 RAG 系统的生产环境部署与调优经验
human_notes: Candidate has direct RAG product practice and RAG was integrated into a fully delivered LLM/conversational product covering requirements through launch/iteration. Frozen evidence does NOT explicitly prove independent production-environment RAG deployment, operations, or dedicated production tuning. Meaningful direct overlap exists but is materially incomplete.

requirement_text: 有开放平台 / 插件生态 / MCP 建设经验
human_notes: Candidate has Agent, RAG and AI-tool experience, but no verified evidence of building an open platform, plugin ecosystem, third-party developer access mechanism, or MCP infrastructure. Adjacent AI capabilities that do not demonstrate the requested platform-ecosystem construction capability.

requirement_text: 熟练使用 SQL 且 具备 A/B 实验设计与执行能力
human_notes: SQL is directly and strongly evidenced. Candidate also has controlled-experiment / ablation experience through JobPilot evaluation work (controlled model comparisons; fixed Dataset/GT/scoring; Prompt A/B/C ablation; control-variable and comparative experimental design). This is NOT equivalent to real-user randomized online A/B testing, traffic splitting, or production experimentation. The A/B experimentation subclaim therefore has meaningful but incomplete evidence and the combined requirement is Partial. (Do not rewrite JobPilot prompt/model evaluation as production online A/B testing.)

requirement_text: 具备 Agent 设计能力 且 Agent 专项评测能力
human_notes: Candidate has meaningful Agent/conversational-product delivery experience and model/Agent product evaluation practice, but Agent-specific design depth and a dedicated Agent evaluation/quality-regression system are not fully evidenced. Both subclaims have meaningful but incomplete support.

requirement_text: 有企业级产品经验 且 完整商业化闭环经验
human_notes: Candidate has platform-style/configurable product experience and product ownership from requirements through delivery, but explicit enterprise SaaS/multi-tenant ownership is incomplete and there is no strong frozen evidence of full pricing/conversion/renewal/commercialisation-loop ownership. Meaningful overlap exists but the complete compound capability is not demonstrated.

requirement_text: 具备 LLM 应用交付能力 且 模型精度调优能力
human_notes: LLM application delivery is strongly evidenced through complete product delivery and LLM-related work. Model performance evaluation/training support exists, but does not prove fine-tuning, model-precision optimization, foundation-model training, RL training, or equivalent model-tuning ownership. One core subclaim is strong while the other remains materially unsupported.

requirement_text: 有数据开发经验 且 数据治理全流程经验
human_notes: Data development is directly supported by data architecture, automated ETL, SQL and data-modeling practice. End-to-end data-governance experience — metadata management, lineage, governance process and ownership — is not evidenced. Compound requirement only partially met.

requirement_text: 独立承担过大型 AI Infra 系统的设计、开发与调测
human_notes: Candidate has real system-design, LLM backend integration and AI technical delivery experience, which meaningfully overlaps with the requested capability. Insufficient evidence of independent ownership of a large-scale AI infrastructure platform covering design, development and debugging. Scale, infra specialization and ownership remain material gaps.

requirement_text: 有大规模标注体系与训练数据闭环的专项经验
human_notes: Human evaluator confirms real manual data-annotation experience, in addition to training-data/model-evaluation exposure. Current frozen evidence does not demonstrate ownership of a large-scale annotation system, annotation-quality framework, specialist annotation platform, or end-to-end training-data closed loop. Meaningful direct overlap exists but is materially incomplete.
